subject: Approval needed: strategic discount request for CloudNexus Enterprise PO
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@cloudnexus.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudNexus Procurement <procurement@cloudnexus.com>
Date: 2026-02-18 09:12 PST
Subject: Pricing and contract questions for Enterprise PO

Hi Rohan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — product looked solid. Procurement asked me to confirm final pricing and whether Redwood can accommodate a steeper discount for our first-year committed spend. Our procurement target is $1.2M committed ARR with a 2-year term; to make the economics work with internal stakeholders we need ~35% off list for year one, plus a 60-day net payment term.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can approve that level of discount and the payment terms? If not, what flexibility do you have on packaging (e.g., smaller seat counts + usage credits) to get to that effective price?

I’ve attached the RFP line items for reference.

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform Strategy
CloudNexus Inc
attachments: CloudNexus_RFP_LineItems.xlsx (spreadsheet, 85KB)
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@cloudnexus.com>
Date: 2026-02-18 10:03 PST
Subject: Re: Pricing and contract questions for Enterprise PO

Samantha —

Appreciate the clear context and the RFP. Short answer: we can make meaningful concessions for strategic customers, but 35% exceeds my self-serve/onsales approval thresholds and will need an exception. I’ve sketched two paths below so procurement can see options quickly:

Option A (Preferred for CloudNexus onboarding):
- 30% off list for year one on committed ARR of $1.2M, 2-year term
- Maintain standard 30-day payment term, provide $75k onboarding credit (applied Q1)
- Product bundle: Redwood Optimize + 24/7 support add-on included for year one

Option B (Lower cash impact, easier approval):
- 20% off list + $150k usage credit drawn down against overages
- 60-day net payment term allowed if backed by PO + finance contact

I’m escalating Option A as a price-exception request to my leadership and finance for VP/CFO sign-off — planning to request the 35% only if we believe CloudNexus brings strategic value (market reference, case study, logo prominence). Can you confirm any must-have terms (e.g., strict 60-day payment, indemnities) so I include them in the memo?

I’ve attached a short exception request PDF I’ll route internally.

Thanks — I’ll follow up by EOD tomorrow with status.

— Rohan
Rohan Mehta | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
attachments: discount-exception-request-CloudNexus.pdf (pdf, 42KB)
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-19 08:27 PST
Subject: Internal: Price-exception request — CloudNexus (DN-2026-0047) — VP/CFO approval needed

Team —

Quick summary: CloudNexus (prospect) is moving to PO stage and has requested a 35% discount on a $1.2M committed ARR, 2-year term, plus 60-day payment terms. They’re strategic — potential case study, integration partnership in APAC roadmap. Procurement has been explicit that anything <35% will not clear their economic committee.

Why escalate: 35% exceeds our delegated discount limits for EPD/sales and will materially change expected margin for the deal. They are asking also to soften payment terms to 60 days which increases working capital exposure.

What I’m asking for:
1) VP approval for a 30% off-list discount (fast path) OR
2) CFO sign-off for a 35% exceptional discount + acceptance of 60-day net payment + permission to include a $75k onboarding credit and Redwood Optimize bundle.

Key deal facts (for finance):
- ACV: $1,200,000 (year 1 committed)
- Term: 2 years (automatic renewal)
- Proposed concession impact: ~33% gross margin reduction year 1 vs standard pricing (finance calc attached)
- Strategic upside: public case study + marketplace listing (estimated 15% ARR upside over 3 years)

Attachments: discount-exception-request-CloudNexus.pdf (request memo), CloudNexus_RFP_LineItems.xlsx

Proposed conditional controls if exception granted:
- DocuSign signature of amended SOW and PO prior to provisioning
- One-time onboarding credit (non-recurring) documented in SOW
- Payment guarantee: PO + remittance schedule, finance to decide escrow if CFO requires

Laura / Vivek — if you can indicate whether you (a) approve 30% now, or (b) are willing to green-light 35% with the controls above, I’ll loop to procurement and legal to finalize language this afternoon.

Thanks,
Rohan
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-19 11:04 PST
Subject: Re: Internal: Price-exception request — CloudNexus (DN-2026-0047) — VP/CFO approval needed

Rohan —

Thanks for the thorough memo and numbers. A few questions before I can sign off for 35%:
1) Please confirm the blended gross margin forecast after the concession for years 1 and 2 (we need a P&L view).
2) Confirm whether the $75k onboarding credit is refundable/recoupable and whether it reduces recognized revenue or is classified as a contra-revenue marketing credit.
3) Can Procurement provide a binding PO with the 60-day term and a named finance contact for collections? We need that to underwrite the AR risk.

Given the strategic upside, I am prepared to approve a one-time 30% discount today provided we get: PO signed within 10 business days, DocuSign amended SOW with onboarding credit language, and a payment schedule in place. I will consider 35% only if the forecast shows the marketplace upside (min. $180k incremental ARR over 3 years) and the PO/escrow mechanics are in place.

If you can provide the P&L and confirm PO timing by EOD, I’ll prioritize final review.

— Laura
Laura Bennett | VP, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-20 16:07 PST
Subject: Re: Internal: Price-exception request — CloudNexus (DN-2026-0047) — VP/CFO approval needed

Team —

I reviewed the memo and the strategic context. I authorize the sales organization to offer up to 30% discount immediately (conditional on Laura’s PO and DocuSign controls). For the 35% ask I’m willing to escalate to the CFO (Laura) for final sign-off but only if Rohan secures the procurement PO with the 60-day term and we get an explicit marketing/case-study commitment from CloudNexus leadership in writing.

Rohan — proceed with Option A (30%) to keep momentum. If Samantha returns firm on the 35% requirement, flag it to me and I will support further escalation.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | SVP, Global Sales
Redwood Inference
